title: adoxa moschatellina var. insularis
intro: Adoxa moschatellina var. insularis, commonly known as Island Sweetshrub, is a variety of the Sweetshrub plant, which is a type of flowering shrub native to the Americas. The Island Sweetshrub has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as relief from digestive issues and respiratory problems. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its use in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of the Island Sweetshrub include essential oils, flavonoids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
